equip_leveling.title: Equip Leveling
equip_leveling.config.title: Equip Leveling Settings
equip_leveling.config.category.general.d: One big slider controls the whole mod. Open "Advanced options" below if you want to fine-tune anything.
equip_leveling.config.category.xp_reward: How much XP each item needs to level up, and how much XP you earn for digging, mining and fighting. Every group starts closed, so the screen stays short - open only what you want to change.
equip_leveling.config.category.enchantin: What the enchanting table offers when your item is ready: how often each reward appears, the price to reroll, the material upgrade order, and how many enchantment slots each item can hold.
equip_leveling.config.sub.requirements.d: How much XP each item needs before it can level up. Bigger number = slower leveling.
equip_leveling.config.sub.actions.desc: How much XP you earn for one kill, one log, one block of dirt, and so on.
equip_leveling.config.sub.ore.desc: How much XP a pickaxe earns when it mines these ores.
equip_leveling.config.sub.custom.desc: Give XP for blocks the mod does not know about yet. Use the big button to browse every block in the game, or type entries by hand below.
equip_leveling.config.sub.weights.desc: These numbers decide how likely each reward is. Higher number = that reward shows up more often.
equip_leveling.config.sub.reroll.desc: The price, in XP levels, of rolling three new offers at the enchanting table. It depends on how many enchantment slots are already full.
equip_leveling.config.sub.tiers.desc: The order materials upgrade through when you get a legendary upgrade (wood -> stone -> iron -> ...). This list is filled in automatically from the materials found in the game, including modded ones. Delete a row to leave it out.
equip_leveling.config.sub.max_slots.desc: How many enchantment slots each item can have. Tools with few enchantments (shovels, hoes) start lower so they can still reach max level. Mending is given once an item reaches its slot cap.
equip_leveling.config.xp_multiplier.tool: 1 = normal speed. 0.5 = half speed (items level up twice as slowly). 2 = double speed. 10 = very fast. Drag it and see.
equip_leveling.config.xp_threshold: Show XP gains above this number
equip_leveling.config.xp_threshold.toolt: Only XP gains at or above this number show a floating message. Set to 0 to show everything.
equip_leveling.config.durability_restore: How much of the item's missing durability is repaired every time it levels up.
equip_leveling.config.keep_on_death: Keep leveled items when you die
equip_leveling.config.keep_on_death.tool: On: leveled equipment stays in your inventory when you die. Other items still drop.
equip_leveling.config.broken_mechanic.to: When an item reaches zero durability it becomes [BROKEN] and stops working instead of disappearing. Repair it at an anvil with the right material.
equip_leveling.config.anvil_base.tooltip: XP levels charged to repair an item at an anvil, before its level is added.
equip_leveling.config.anvil_per_level.to: Extra XP levels added to the anvil price for every level the item has.
equip_leveling.config.base_xp.tooltip: XP needed for a %s to reach its first level-up.
equip_leveling.config.entity_kill_xp.too: XP for killing a mob. Tougher mobs give proportionally more.
equip_leveling.config.log_xp.tooltip: XP for breaking a log or stem with an axe.
equip_leveling.config.shovel_xp.tooltip: XP for breaking dirt, sand, gravel or snow with a shovel.
equip_leveling.config.clay_xp.tooltip: XP for breaking clay with a shovel. Clay is denser and rarer, so it grants more.
equip_leveling.config.hoe_xp.tooltip: XP for harvesting a mature crop with a hoe.
equip_leveling.config.stone_xp.tooltip: XP for breaking common stone-type blocks (stone, deepslate, andesite, etc.) with a pickaxe.
equip_leveling.config.rare_ore_xp.toolti: XP for mining diamond, emerald, ancient debris and other rare ores.
equip_leveling.config.custom_block_xp.to: Add blocks that give XP when mined. Format each entry as blockid:xp, e.g. minecraft:deepslate:25. Use the + button to add.
equip_leveling.config.upgrade_weight.too: How likely an offer upgrades an enchantment you already have, relative to the other reward weights.
equip_leveling.config.new_slot_weight.to: How likely an offer adds a brand new enchantment to an empty slot, relative to the other reward weights.
equip_leveling.config.legendary_chance.t: One flat chance per visit that one of the three offers is a material upgrade (iron -> diamond, etc.) instead of an enchantment. This is checked once, not three times.
equip_leveling.config.reroll_cost.toolti: XP levels spent to reroll when %d standard slots are filled.
equip_leveling.config.material_tiers.too: Materials upgrade in this order. The list starts with the materials the game detected automatically; delete a row to leave it out, type a name to add one.
equip_leveling.config.max_slots.tooltip: The maximum number of enchantment slots a %s can hold. Raise it up to 8 if you use enchantment mods that add many more options.
